outcome: Thickness of the remaining muscular layer
cohort: 51 women with caesarean scar defects or a remaining muscular layer thickness of less than 3 mm
finding: Vaginal repair of caesarean scar diverticula led to improvements in gynaecological outcomes and resulted in satisfactory obstetric outcomes, with a low rate of uterine rupture in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: This study evaluated the obstetrical outcomes of vaginal repair for caesarean scar diverticula, finding satisfactory subsequent outcomes with no reported uterine ruptures in those achieving pregnancy after repair.
